objective: 按照已有数据及资料及成果，重新测试与构建模型与创新点，直到达到投稿门槛
previous_goal_turn_classification: progress: ten background-modifier fits, close-literature revision, actual external input preflight and verified GitHub backup were completed
this_goal_turn_classification: progress: all 28 menu pairs enumerated, direct paired contrasts computed, both eligible conditional restrictions tested, exact conditional power and sharp hypothetical drift bounds evaluated

criteria.requirement: Independently meaningful originality, without relabelling or stitching established theories
criteria.finding: Fibre ranks/information coincide with classical lack-of-fit constructions. Nearby app/health-data papers already cover the proposed attribute and subgroup themes. No new substantive mechanism has stable support.

criteria.requirement: Retest existing records and rebuild identified models
criteria.finding: Pooled 360-record analyses, source sensitivities, panel/mixture comparisons, ten background contrasts and instrument-driven paired checks are complete. Numerical validity is not publication readiness.

criteria.requirement: Evidence can support the central substantive claim
criteria.finding: No direct single-rule-only matched menu pair; task order fixed; within-version conditional free-cell representation saturated. Descriptive price-menu shifts are available, but they do not identify a pure control mechanism or causal price response.

criteria.requirement: Empirical evidence appropriate to the central contribution actually claimed
criteria.finding: The 360-record questionnaire supplies exploratory application evidence subject to the stated source and modeling conditions. It does not establish an independently new method or identify the stronger causal mechanisms. The attempted public archive was not counted as validation success. A second external dataset is not treated as a universal journal requirement; evidence must match the particular contribution.

criteria.requirement: Accurate respondent provenance and research statements
criteria.finding: Access restored. Two 30-record AI-sample task notices and all 60 corresponding 0.5-point log entries inspected. Applicability of the researcher-reported human-recruitment description remains unverified. No label- or model-based identity finding is made.

criteria.requirement: Coherent manuscript, appendix, reproducible code and submission materials aligned to established claims
criteria.finding: Drafts and appendices match the observed evidence. A formal new-method submission package is not labelled ready when its central contribution has not been established.

remaining_work_requires: Task-specific service description or execution evidence resolving the two 30-record AI-sample tasks; no further unlock or login is currently required
